studies.title: Haʻamonga ʻa Maui — c. 1800
studies.caption: About 1800. Two coral-stone uprights carry the lintel of Haʻamonga ʻa Maui.
studies.prompt: Low three-quarter Tongatapu trilithon exactly TWO massive coral-limestone upright slabs and ONE horizontal lintel seated in notches, tropical grass and palms; no Stonehenge circle.
